response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack software engineer with 14+ years of experience and strong software craftsmanship practices, this role requires specialized expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, AI accelerator optimization, and deep-learning workload analysis that are entirely absent from his background. His career has been concentrated in web, backend, and full-stack software development rather than hardware architecture and hardware-software co-design.
strengths: 14+ years of professional software development experience meeting educational requirements (BS + 8+ years)
Demonstrated expertise in low-latency systems and performance optimization (Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
Strong systems architecture and distributed systems design capabilities across microservices and cloud platforms
concerns: No SoC or IP modeling experience—a core responsibility and required skill for the role
No GPU architecture, AI accelerator optimization, or deep neural network workload expertise
Career focus on full-stack and web software development rather than hardware architecture and hardware-software co-design

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and GPU architecture expertise
No AI accelerator and deep-learning workload optimization background
Performance optimization and system design experience
